name: python-scheduler-api
title: Python job scheduler
blurb: A durable scheduler: a ticker claims due jobs under a write lock, interval jobs reschedule into the future instead of stampeding to catch up, failures back off up to max_attempts, and every attempt lands in a run ledger.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing && uv pip install -e . pytest httpx ruff

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest httpx ruff

verify.name: migrate
verify.cmd: work=$(mktemp -d) && .venv/bin/python -c "from {{ package_name }}.db import connect, migrate; c = connect('$work/check.db'); assert migrate(c) == ['001_jobs.sql']; assert migrate(c) == []; c.close()" && rm -rf "$work"

verify.name: http
verify.cmd:
set -e
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5457/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "port 5457 is already answering - stop that process before running this step" >&2
  exit 1
fi
work=$(mktemp -d)
.venv/bin/uvicorn {{ package_name }}.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5457 --log-level warning >.scheduler-http.log 2>&1 &
server=$!
trap 'kill -TERM -"$server" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; for _ in $(seq 1 20); do kill -0 $server 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.1; done; kill -KILL $server 2>/dev/null || true; wait $server 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
for _ in $(seq 1 200); do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5457/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 0.25
done
kill -0 $server
DB_PATH=$work/extra.db
body=$work/body.json
base=http://127.0.0.1:5457
fail=0
ok() { echo "ok $1"; }
bad() { echo "FAIL $1: $2"; fail=1; }
expect() { if [ "$2" = "$3" ]; then ok "$1"; else bad "$1" "want [$3] got [$2]"; fi; }
contains() { case "$2" in *"$3"*) ok "$1" ;; *) bad "$1" "missing [$3] in [$2]" ;; esac; }
call() { curl -sS -o "$body" -w '%{http_code}' "$@"; }
field() { sed -n "s/.*\"$1\":\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" "$body"; }
count() { .venv/bin/python -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["count"])' "$body"; }
wait_field() {
  id=$1 want=$2 tries=0
  while [ $tries -lt 200 ]; do
    call "$base/jobs/$id" >/dev/null
    if [ "$(field status)" = "$want" ]; then return 0; fi
    tries=$((tries + 1)); sleep 0.05
  done
  return 1
}

expect health "$(call "$base/health")" 200
contains health_status "$(cat "$body")" '"status":"ok"'

expect create "$(call -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"digest","payload":"a b\nc\n","run_at":9999999999}' "$base/jobs")" 201
job=$(field id)
if [ -n "$job" ]; then ok created_id; else bad created_id "empty"; fi
expect run_now "$(call -X POST "$base/jobs/$job/run")" 200
if wait_field "$job" done; then ok once_done; else bad once_done "never finished"; fi
call "$base/jobs/$job/runs" >/dev/null
expect runs_count "$(count)" 1
contains run_words "$(cat "$body")" '"words":3'

expect interval_create "$(call -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"beat","payload":"a\n","interval_seconds":0.05}' "$base/jobs")" 201
beat=$(field id)
runs=0
for _ in $(seq 1 200); do
  call "$base/jobs/$beat/runs" >/dev/null
  runs=$(count)
  if [ "$runs" -ge 2 ]; then break; fi
  sleep 0.05
done
if [ "$runs" -ge 2 ]; then ok interval_repeats; else bad interval_repeats "runs=$runs"; fi
call "$base/jobs/$beat" >/dev/null
contains interval_pending "$(cat "$body")" '"status":"pending"'

expect explode_create "$(call -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"boom","kind":"explode","max_attempts":2}' "$base/jobs")" 201
boom=$(field id)
if wait_field "$boom" failed; then ok retry_capped; else bad retry_capped "never failed"; fi
call "$base/jobs/$boom" >/dev/null
contains attempts "$(cat "$body")" '"attempts":2'
contains last_error "$(cat "$body")" 'RuntimeError'

expect late_create "$(call -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"late","run_at":1,"interval_seconds":60}' "$base/jobs")" 201
late=$(field id)
sleep 0.3
call "$base/jobs/$late" >/dev/null
contains late_pending "$(cat "$body")" '"status":"pending"'
call "$base/jobs/$late/runs" >/dev/null
expect late_runs_once "$(count)" 1

expect blank_name "$(call -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"  "}' "$base/jobs")" 422
contains blank_error "$(cat "$body")" 'invalid_request'
expect bad_kind "$(call -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"x","kind":"shell"}' "$base/jobs")" 422
expect unknown_job "$(call "$base/jobs/deadbeef")" 404
contains unknown_detail "$(cat "$body")" 'no job with id deadbeef'
expect not_found "$(call "$base/nope")" 404
contains not_found_detail "$(cat "$body")" 'no route for GET /nope'
expect wrong_method "$(call -X PATCH "$base/health")" 405
expect delete "$(call -X DELETE "$base/jobs/$job")" 204
expect deleted "$(call "$base/jobs/$job")" 404

if [ "$fail" -ne 0 ]; then echo "scheduler contract failed" >&2; exit 1; fi
